lens: Evaluation design audit; no assessment of candidate quality

findings.observation: The collected checks demonstrate individual synthetic state transitions; they do not establish a calibrated end-to-end experience score or human satisfaction.
findings.evidence: Artifact 9938d394 with resident backend 973e7913-platform; evidence/manifest.json; plans/2026-09-24-experience-98.md lists unverified native, latency and recovery gates.
findings.user_impact: An aggregate 98 claim could conceal duplicate writes, inaccessible states or provider failures.
findings.recommendation: Freeze atomic journey criteria, distinguish failures from missing evidence, and withhold the threshold claim while critical gates remain.
findings.verification: Every awarded point has a reproducible locator on the tested revision; no active critical gate is averaged away.

strengths: Synthetic fixtures are isolated from real relationship records.
Before/after PostgreSQL regressions and canonical browser readbacks distinguish mechanisms from visual opinion.
missing_evidence: Independent human task-comprehension and seeded-error trials.
Rater calibration or repeat/order stability for subjective craft judgments.
Full state/locale/device coverage and resident-runtime acceptance.
open_questions: Which user-observed outcomes should complement the internal technical scorecard after release gates pass?
